reason: timing QC of the first run failed (identical-path discordance above 1%); decisions are not re-run
qc_rule: identical-path pairs (LRS vs the DCS or PBS search it executes) differing by more than 1.5x must be <= 1%
reporting_rule: the re-timed run replaces the original runtime endpoints only if its timing QC passes and every decision equals the original run; otherwise both runs are reported and the configuration is marked timing-unresolved. Decisions (G1, G4 inputs) of the original run are kept.
